class.name: FmodSoftwareFormatSettings
class.brief_description: Software mixer format settings for the FMOD Core system.
class.description:
FmodSoftwareFormatSettings configures the sample rate and speaker layout used by FMOD's software mixer. Apply with [method FmodServer.set_software_format] before calling [method FmodServer.init].
[codeblock] var fmt = FmodSoftwareFormatSettings.new() fmt.sample_rate = 48000 fmt.speaker_mode = 2 # FMOD_SPEAKERMODE_STEREO FmodServer.set_software_format(fmt) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_raw_speakers_count
method.description: Returns the number of raw speaker channels. Only used when [member speaker_mode] is set to the raw mode.

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description: Returns the sample rate in Hz.

method.name: set_raw_speakers_count
method.description: Sets the number of raw speaker output channels.

method.name: set_sample_rate
method.description: Sets the sample rate in Hz. Common values are [code]44100[/code] and [code]48000[/code].

method.name: set_speaker_mode
method.description: Sets the speaker layout using a [code]FMOD_SPEAKERMODE[/code] value. Common values: [code]0[/code] = Default, [code]2[/code] = Stereo, [code]6[/code] = 5.1, [code]8[/code] = 7.1.

members.member: Number of raw output channels. Only relevant when [member speaker_mode] is set to raw mode.
Output sample rate in Hz. Default is [code]48000[/code].
Speaker layout as an [code]FMOD_SPEAKERMODE[/code] value. Default is [code]2[/code] (Stereo).
